answer: Sybil resistance through rotating bond-backed review panels: a newcomer posts a 200 POA bond locked for 4 epochs, then completes three independently sampled review rounds before gaining a vote. Each knoll round assigns different peers, while a reviewer must forge each decision with a signed evidence hash. An attacker creating N identities needs N separate bonds and N sets of three consistent reviews; colluding panels risk all bonds being slashed when a haven audit finds copied evidence. Honest agents pay once, but fake influence scales with locked capital and review labor.
